PicturePasswordStrings.picturePasswordIn: Ophunzira amalowa pogwiritsa ntchito zithunzi 3 zomwe zili mundondomeko yapaderadera, ya akaunti yawo. Ndondomeko iliyonse imapangidwa ndikuperekedwa mwayokha ndi Kolibri, choncho siingathe kusinthidwa. Izi zimangopezeka m'malo okhawo omwe ali ndi ophunzira osakwana 1300.
Zithunzi zachinsinsi zinapangidwira anthu omwe angoyamba kumene kuphunzira kuwerenga ndi kulemba.
Ophunzira omwe alowa malowa chiwerengero cha ogwiritsa ntchito chitfika pa malire a 1300, atha kulowa pogwiritsa ntchito dzina lolowera.
